name: Dumbbell Goblet Squat
steps: Stand with feet slightly wider than shoulder width and toes angled gently outward.
Hold one dumbbell vertically against your chest by cupping its upper end with both palms.
Brace your abdomen and bend your hips and knees, lowering between your feet as far as you can keep your heels grounded.
Drive through your whole feet to stand tall, keeping your chest upright.
tips: Keep the dumbbell close to your chest as your knees track over your toes.
Keep your heels planted flat and your elbows pointed downward throughout the squat.
